message.content: {"answer": "C", "option_text": "Massive right pleural effusion causing left mediastinal shift", "reason": "Visual inspection of the original image reveals complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a visible meniscus and significant contralateral (leftward) displacement of the mediastinum and trachea. This mass effect is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion, distinguishing it from atelectasis (which would cause ipsilateral shift) or pneumothorax (which would typically show hyperlucency rather than dense opacity)."}
